title: pyflightstream 0.32 probe round 1 on FlightStream 26.124

probes.moved: nothing: the instruments and the licence checkout
probes.evidence: sentinel printed, return code 0, log_s01 names FlightStream version 26.1 build 8172026

probes.moved: the CCS file imported by CCS_IMPORT (the control of the file)
commands: CCS_IMPORT / CLOSE_COMPONENT_ENDS DISABLE / UPDATE_PROPERTIES DISABLE / CLEAR_EXISTING ENABLE / FILE <round1>/inputs/r1_ccs3.csv
probes.evidence: boundary_names of state_after.fsm = PYFS_CCS_WING, PYFS_CCS_FUS, PYFS_CCS_REV; OBJ export 12937 faces (4484, 3792, 4661 by group)

probes.moved: a wing lofted by the CCS script commands, defaults
commands: CAD_CREATE_WING_MESH_FROM_CCS PYFS_WING TRUE SHARP TRUE C2 C0
probes.verdict: CAD_CREATE_WING_MESH_FROM_CCS verified; the other three accepted, unprobed
probes.evidence: boundary_names = PYFS_WING; OBJ 4484 faces, equal to the wing group of C0

probes.moved: CCS_WING_MESH_SUBDIVISIONS CHORD 30 added to C1, nothing else
commands: CAD_CREATE_WING_MESH_FROM_CCS PYFS_WING TRUE SHARP TRUE C2 C0
probes.evidence: OBJ 588 faces here against 4484 in C1; boundary PYFS_WING present

probes.moved: NEW_CCS_WING_CONTROL_SURFACE added to C1, nothing else
probes.evidence: crash log: ERROR | Scripting | Error in script at line 24 ... Review command syntax and arguments; the sentinel after it never printed; state_after.fsm and mesh_all.obj were not written; the command is not reported as unrecognised

probes.moved: a fuselage lofted by the CCS script commands
probes.evidence: boundary_names = PYFS_FUS; OBJ 3871 faces (3792 in the C0 import of the same component)

probes.moved: a body of revolution lofted by the CCS script commands
commands: CAD_CREATE_REVOLVE_MESH_FROM_CCS PYFS_REV 1 X 0.0 360.0 TRUE C2 C2
probes.evidence: boundary_names = PYFS_REV; OBJ 4661 faces, equal to the revolve group of C0

probes.moved: the Relaxed_TE direction digit of the CCS file = 0
commands: CCS_IMPORT / CLOSE_COMPONENT_ENDS DISABLE / UPDATE_PROPERTIES DISABLE / CLEAR_EXISTING ENABLE / FILE <round1>/inputs/r1_g35_axial.csv

probes.moved: the Relaxed_TE direction digit of the CCS file = 1
commands: CCS_IMPORT / CLOSE_COMPONENT_ENDS DISABLE / UPDATE_PROPERTIES DISABLE / CLEAR_EXISTING ENABLE / FILE <round1>/inputs/r1_g35_azimuth.csv
probes.verdict: accepted, verified as an import; the saved state differs from G35a in 5 lines; the effect of the digit is not observed
probes.evidence: boundary_names = PYFS_CCS_FUS; cross_files_differ state_after.fsm True (5 differing lines); the differing lines were not decoded and no geometry was compared

probes.moved: DELETE_SURFACES 3 on the four-boundary library mesh
probes.verdict: verified: the boundary at index 3 is removed and the one after it takes index 3
probes.evidence: inventory before: Body, Base, Blade1, Blade2; after: Body, Base, Blade2; the OBJ export of index 3 after holds only Blade2 (1040 faces)

probes.verdict: verified: DISABLE changes the stored state
probes.evidence: byte comparison of three saves: default vs ENABLE differ (2 lines), ENABLE vs DISABLE differ (1 line), default vs DISABLE differ

probes.moved: ACOUSTIC_SOURCES DISABLE (the control of A1, one token)
commands: CREATE_ACOUSTIC_SECTION / FRAME 1 / PLANE YZ / OFFSET 0.0 / RADIAL_OBSERVERS 2 / AZIMUTH_OBSERVERS 4 / INNER_RADIUS 5.0 / OUTER_RADIUS 10.0 / STORAGE_PATH <round1>/runs/A0_acoustic_sources_off/section
probes.verdict: the chain ran to its end; every pressure value exported is zero
probes.evidence: signals.txt: 3 observers of 16 rows each, PL, PT and PO all exactly 0.0; section folder holds 16 VTK files

probes.moved: ACOUSTIC_SOURCES ENABLE (A1 and A0 differ in this token only)
commands: CREATE_ACOUSTIC_SECTION / FRAME 1 / PLANE YZ / OFFSET 0.0 / RADIAL_OBSERVERS 2 / AZIMUTH_OBSERVERS 4 / INNER_RADIUS 5.0 / OUTER_RADIUS 10.0 / STORAGE_PATH <round1>/runs/A1_acoustic_chain/section
probes.verdict: ACOUSTIC_SOURCES, CREATE_NEW_ACOUSTIC_OBSERVER, EXPORT_ACOUSTIC_SIGNALS and CREATE_ACOUSTIC_SECTION verified; the other three accepted, unprobed
probes.evidence: signals.txt: 3 observers (PYFS_OBS1 created, two imported) of 16 rows, PL and PO nonzero (largest absolute values 0.38, 0.41 and 0.24 in the file's pressure unit), PT exactly 0.0; section folder holds 16 VTK files
